description: One slot's occupant on the wire: a human reviewer, or an agent reviewer under a named Execution Profile. A human slot carries no profile and is exempt from separation (DR-EP-15); a profile slot names its entry by reference, never inlined values.

oneOf.description: An agent reviews under the profile `name` references.

name.description: The Execution Profile the slot's assignment names, by its catalogue name.
